explanation: Model evidence concentrates in: nose (+0.242 mass over centre-prior), eyes (+0.001 mass over centre-prior) -- these regions received more of the model's attention than a centred-face prior alone would predict. Artifact classifier's top filter type: smoothing. Supporting measurement on this image: skin-texture variance (Laplacian) = 135.8 (within the authentic reference range 52.4-299.9, median 137.0). On our paired held-out test these measurements separate filtered from authentic faces at AUROC as low as 0.55, close to chance for a single image, so they are reported as measurements and are not the basis for the classification, which rests on the model's learned features. On a held-out set with independent ground-truth masks this map beats a centre-prior baseline overall (IoU@10% 0.61 vs 0.57, paired diff significant), though the margin varies by filter type and is not significant for face_reshaping -- this is supporting, not conclusive, evidence.
